Serco-NA is seeking a motivated individual to serve as an IB-CHE/PMDT Developer in the Submarine Industrial Base Data Analytics Team, (IB-CHE: Industrial Base – Cloud Hosting Environment/ PMDT: Product & Manufacturing Digital Twin) supporting high-visibility initiatives that enhance the readiness, resilience, and performance of the U.S. Navy’s Submarine Industrial Base (SIB).

Must be able to obtain U.S. Department of War (DoW) Secret security clearance.

In this role, you will systematically map, analyze, and plan the digital transformation efforts across all areas/departments. The core deliverable is a comprehensive portfolio that outlines current capabilities, future requirements, and strategic roadmaps for technology integration, ensuring all digital investments are aligned, and directly support mission objectives.

This position operates in a fast-paced environment requiring daily interaction with suppliers, government stakeholders, and industry partners. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors.

Program Overview

The Submarine Industrial Base (SIB) Program leads the U.S. Navy's effort to revitalize America's shipbuilding and repair capabilities. Established in September 2024, the program strengthens and expands the industrial base that builds and maintains surface ships, aircraft carriers, and submarines vital to national defense.

https://www.secnav.navy.mil/rda/mib/Pages/default.aspx

The acquisition of COLUMBIA Class Submarines, including R&D, design, construction, Test and Evaluation (T&E), and Live Fire Test and Evaluation (LFT&E). Identify and annotate objects within the defined Region of Interest (ROI), while applying masks outside the ROI as per guidelines

Interpret multi-feed image data (RGB, thermal, grayscale) with high precision, distinguishing between overlapping or partially occluded objects

Maintain high accuracy and productivity metrics aligned with program expectations and weekly targets

Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and quality guidelines consistently across all annotation tasks

Review and validate annotations to ensure defect-free outputs, flagging edge cases or ambiguous frames for escalation

Quickly adapt to feedback from quality audits and apply learnings to improve annotation quality in subsequent batches

Participate in training and nesting phases, achieving ramp-up within defined timelines and demonstrating readiness through qualification assessments

Maintain data confidentiality and adhere to security protocols when handling image and video data from fulfillment centers

Collaborate with team leads and quality analysts to support continuous improvement in annotation accuracy and throughput

Associates work in 24x7 environment with rotational shifts. Associates would be working in a 9 hour shift, including pre-scheduled breaks.
